cases.case_label: Frameshift Alu insertion in a TG exon causing congenital hypothyroidism
cases.disease: Congenital hypothyroidism with goiter and undetectable serum thyroglobulin
cases.mechanism_detail: Two of four siblings in a consanguineous Sudanese family with congenital hypothyroidism, goiter, high thyrotropin and undetectable serum thyroglobulin carried a novel Alu element inserted within an exon of TG, producing a frameshift (p.Y3637Ffs). The exon number and transcript consequences are not given.
cases.quote: a novel frameshift insertion of an Alu element within an exon of the TG gene: c.7909ins p.Y3637Ffs
